title: How To Sell More Extended Warranties Right The First Time
channel: Gary Lee Stanley Your Sales Guy
summary: A sales trainer coaches F&I-style salespeople on pitching extended warranties, service agreements and replacement guarantees as peace-of-mind insurance.

assertions.quote: it waits till the warranty is over with and it goes whoops

verdicts.note: Failure timing is mostly driven by component wear-out distributions rather than a documented spike right after warranty expiry; this is an availability-bias claim from sales anecdotes.

assertions.quote: even if they never use it it's again a peace of mind

verdicts.note: Peace of mind is a subjective psychological benefit that can't be verified or falsified.

Abito & Salant find the estimated risk-aversion parameter is "statistically indistinguishable from zero" -- the genuine risk-reduction value that risk aversion would capture doesn't explain warranty demand; probability distortion (a decision-making mistake) does instead.

assertions.quote: we do offer a service for just a small amount that can cover it up to full replacement

verdicts.note: Some contracts do offer replacement, but many cap payouts or pay depreciated value, so 'full replacement' overstates the typical outcome.

assertions.quote: they'll replace it with new what technology

verdicts.note: Some providers replace with a comparable current model, but many instead pay depreciated cash value rather than guaranteeing an upgrade.

assertions.quote: service Agreements are they are warranties they are Insurance

verdicts.note: Extended warranties function like insurance in risk-pooling but are typically not regulated or reserve-backed the way licensed insurance is.

assertions.quote: it's sometimes better to go directly to the company that has sold you the merchandise so that way you can have it serviced

verdicts.note: Whether the seller's own service beats an alternative repairer depends on the specific business, not a generalizable fact.

assertions.quote: if you get your oil change done on your car it's going to make your car last longer

verdicts.note: Scheduled maintenance such as oil changes is well established to reduce wear-related failures and extend service life.
